summary.text: Robert Short is the Republican nominee for Secretary of State. A Converse County commissioner since 2014 and a Douglas businessman, he won the August 18 Republican primary over several candidates including Freedom Caucus chair Rachel Williams. He has raised far more than his opponents, about half of it from loans, per WyoFile.

paragraphs.text: Three-term Converse County Commissioner, first elected in 2014, and vice president of the Wyoming County Commissioners Association.

Worked in power-line construction and uranium mining, studied electrical engineering and computer science, and had a technology and nuclear-science career before starting businesses in Douglas and Glenrock in 2004-05 that his site says grew to more than 120 jobs.
Has served as an election judge.
